notes.sowing: Sow directly where it will grow, {cm:0.6} to {cm:1} deep, from about 2 weeks before your last frost; the taproot makes it hard to transplant. Sow a small batch every 3 weeks while the weather is cool, and again in late summer for a fall crop.
notes.care: Cilantro bolts quickly in hot weather and long days, sooner if the soil dries out. Keep it watered, give it afternoon shade as the weather warms, and choose slow-bolting varieties. Young plants take light frost.
notes.harvest: Cut leaves once plants are about {cm:15} tall, roughly 7 weeks from sowing. For coriander seed, let some plants flower and cut them when the seed heads turn brown, about 3 months from sowing.
